findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe deserialization via pickle, yaml, or marshal
 * @description Detects uses of unsafe deserialization APIs which may process untrusted data.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/unsafe-deserialization-custom
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall()
  or call = API::moduleImport("yaml").getMember(["load", "unsafe_load"]).getACall()
  or call = API::moduleImport("marshal").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall()
select call, "Potentially unsafe deserialization operation that could execute arbitrary code."
findings.hypothesis: Package may use unsafe deserialization APIs that could process untrusted data.

message.text: Potentially unsafe deserialization operation that could execute arbitrary code.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe use of pickle in cache module
 * @description Flags uses of pickle.load/loads in src/snowflake/connector/cache.py
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/snowflake-cache-pickle
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath() = "src/snowflake/connector/cache.py" and
  call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall()
select call, "Use of pickle for caching may be unsafe if fed untrusted data. Ensure only trusted data is deserialized."
findings.hypothesis: pickle deserialization in cache.py may be unsafe

message.text: Use of pickle for caching may be unsafe if fed untrusted data. Ensure only trusted data is deserialized.

findings.codeql_raw_query:

 * @problem.severity note
 * @id py/snowflake-subprocess-usage

 *       external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
